title: Labelling Bug-Fixing Commits with Local Open-Weight Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.21616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Defect prediction depends on knowing which commits fix bugs, yet the labels that encode this are produced by routes that each introduce noise. Reused benchmarks carry documented data-quality problems, issue-tracker links are biased and the underlying reports are frequently mistyped, and matching keywords in commit messages is a coarse heuristic. This paper examines whether commits can be labelled as bug fixes from their content alone, using open-weight language models that run locally and therefore keep the process reproducible, inexpensive at corpus scale, usable on proprietary code, and independent of any issue tracker. Against datasets of manually validated and curated bug fixes spanning Java, Python, and JavaScript, we compare a keyword baseline with a set of open-weight models of varying size, prompting each with the commit message and the code diff. translated_title: 使用本地开放权重语言模型标注缺陷修复提交
translated_abstract: 缺陷预测依赖于知道哪些提交修复了缺陷，然而编码这一信息的标签是由各种会引入噪声的途径产生的。重复使用的基准数据集存在已被记录的数据质量问题，问题跟踪器链接存在偏差且底层的报告经常被错误分类，而在提交信息中匹配关键词则是一种粗糙的启发式方法。本文研究是否可以仅根据提交的内容将其标注为缺陷修复，使用在本地运行的开放权重语言模型，从而保持整个过程可复现、在语料库规模上成本低廉、可用于专有代码，并且不依赖于任何问题跟踪器。在涵盖Java、Python和JavaScript的经过人工验证和整理的缺陷修复数据集上，我们将关键词基线与一组不同规模的开放权重模型进行比较，每个模型都以提交信息和代码差异作为输入。在人工验证的语料库上，关键词基线仅能恢复不到一半的（真实缺陷修复提交）。
tldr: 本文提出使用本地运行的开放权重语言模型，仅根据提交信息和代码差异自动标注缺陷修复提交，避免了传统标注方法（基准数据复用、问题跟踪器链接、关键词匹配）引入的噪声，实现了可复现、低成本、适用于专有代码且不依赖问题跟踪器的缺陷提交标注方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using locally-run open-weight language models to automatically label bug-fixing commits based solely on commit messages and code diffs, avoiding the noise introduced by traditional labeling routes (reused benchmarks, issue-tracker links, keyword matching), and achieving a reproducible, low-cost approach applicable to proprietary code without reliance on issue trackers.
